svg.desc: Isometric partitions and hex clusters: solidarity. One low plinth of many cubes: their sides stay many, their tops merge into one lit deck. After B015 Isometric Allotment (partition, hashed heights, painter's order), B018 Hex Terraces (roots reserve neighbours), B068 Soft Brutalism (flat three-tone light), B098 Terraced Reaction. Structure: ground plan. Process: hashed heights, painted back to front by x+y+z on a (7,4) (-7,4) (0,-8) lattice. Mark: paper on the subject's top, the value's colour on every lit face, ground through the shade face, 3-unit ink where faces meet. Params {nx:7,ny:5,c:4,drop:0}. Seed rng("GEW06-solidarity").
